acceptance_criteria.statement: A task with title, notes, priority, due date, and status open can be created with POST /tasks and answers 201 with its identifier and echoed fields
GET /tasks answers 200 and includes every created task
GET /tasks/{task_id} answers 200 with the exact stored task
PUT /tasks/{task_id} marks a task done and later reopens it, changing only the status
DELETE /tasks/{task_id} answers 204 and a later fetch of the same task answers 404
With an access key configured, a request without the key answers 401
A task placed in a named task list shows that list when fetched, and the list is present in GET /task_lists
Priority and due date set at creation are still present after every status update
A task created without notes or due date answers 201 and stores no due date
